summary: Iteration 7 tested the 4 follow-up enhancements: PDF exports (Class Analytics + AI Insights), Weak Chapter Alert banner, Practice Generator variety/shuffle, and the new Adaptive Live Session feature (teacher launch/monitor/close + public /practice student loop). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_adaptive_and_exports.py (37 tests) — all pass; full suite 156 passed / 1 skipped. Frontend: full Playwright walkthrough of teacher + student sides — all flows pass, including real-time polling monitor, level-change messaging, close/re-join errors, invalid-code toast, and 3x practice generation producing 3 distinct orderings. No functional defects found; 1 minor robustness issue (unhandled clipboard promise rejection) and 1 pre-existing test-hygiene fix applied in conftest.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called without .catch()/try-catch. When the clipboard write permission is denied (non-secure context, Firefox, or restricted browser), it throws NotAllowedError as an unhandled promise rejection which surfaces the React dev error overlay ('Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied') covering the whole page. Recommend wrapping in try/catch with a toast.error fallback (and optionally a textarea fallback copy).

issues: Seeded data quality (not a code bug): Average score 2.5%, Readiness mix shows only 'At Risk x 5' so the bar is a solid red block with no legend segments, and the 'Needs improvement' list shows ~20 chapters all at 0% — visually alarming/low information. Consider capping the list length or adding an 'insufficient data' hint.

action_items: Optional (LOW): add error handling/fallback around navigator.clipboard.writeText in AdaptiveLiveSession.copyCode so a denied clipboard permission shows a toast instead of an unhandled rejection.
critical_code_review_comments: adaptive.py answer(): p['log'] is capped at 50 and participants are embedded in the session doc as a dict keyed by studentName — a session with many students and long logs will grow the single document; acceptable for a class-size session but worth noting if usage scales.

adaptive.py join(): participants are keyed by raw studentName, so two different students entering the same name share one adaptive state (by design for re-join/resume, but a name collision silently merges progress). Consider surfacing that on the teacher monitor.
adaptive.py answer(): correctAnswer is returned only after answering (join payload correctly omits it) — verified no answer leakage on join.

insights.py /alerts returns {count, items} where items is truncated to 5 while count is the untruncated total; Dashboard already handles this ('and N more'), just keep the two in sync if the contract changes.

rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. The 10 pre-existing failures seen when running the whole backend suite were caused by conftest's session-scoped anon_client being mutated with an Authorization header by an earlier test module, making /insights/* anonymous-access assertions get 200 instead of 401; fixed by making anon_client function-scoped (test-only change, no app code touched).
